faq: How do you choose the quick wins?
From a short questionnaire about your tasks and tools, and a review of what you send us. We pick changes that are low risk, cheap and quick to try rather than the most impressive ones.
Do my team need technical skills?
No. Each win is written for a non technical person, with plain steps and copyable prompts. If a step needs a setting changed, we show where to click.
What if a quick win does not work for us?
We explain how to judge it after a week and what to try instead. We aim to pick realistic wins, but we cannot promise a specific result for your business.
Is this different from the opportunity audit?
Yes. The audit ranks many tasks in depth. This plan is shorter and action focused, built for starting this month. Many clients do this first and the audit later.

desc:
An AI quick wins plan for this month gives your team a short list of small changes it can start right away. Ecom Swift LLC picks easy improvements for your business and writes the steps, a sample prompt and a way to check each one worked.

## What is an AI quick wins plan?

An AI quick wins plan is a short list of small, low-risk changes that use AI to save time on tasks you already do. Each one takes an hour or an afternoon to start, needs no new system and comes with exact steps. Examples include writing product notes from a few facts, summarizing a recorded call or sorting incoming email into groups.

The plan is about starting, not about a grand strategy. It helps you get useful results before a larger project is even discussed.

## Why small steps beat big projects

Large AI projects often stall. They need budget, agreement, technical work and patience, and during that time nothing changes. Meanwhile your team keeps spending hours on tasks a small change could shorten.

Quick wins avoid that wait. They are cheap to try, simple to undo and visible to the people doing the work. A team that has saved an hour with a first small change is far more willing to try the next one, and that goodwill matters more than any tool.

## How quick wins improve results

Each quick win targets a task that repeats, so a small saving repeats too. Ten minutes saved on a daily task becomes a real block of time across a month. The effect grows as more wins are added, and the time freed can go back into customers, sales or planning.

The plan also builds skill. People learn how to give clear instructions, how to check a result and where AI struggles. That learning carries into every later project. The actual time saved depends on your tasks and how consistently the steps are followed, so we give you a way to measure each win and see for yourself.

## What a strong quick win includes

- A clearly named task, such as writing reply drafts or summarizing a meeting.
- Step by step instructions your team can follow without technical skills.
- A sample prompt that can be copied and adjusted.
- The person who should do it and a realistic time to set aside.
- The tool or setting needed, often one you already have.
- A simple way to tell whether it worked, such as time per task.
- A note on what not to share while doing it.
- A suggested order to try the wins in.
- A check-in point to decide whether to keep, change or drop it.

## How we build your plan

We begin by asking how your business works: what your team does each day, what takes longest and which tools are already in use. From that, we choose changes that are easy, safe and likely to be noticed.

The Basic package delivers a small set of wins with steps, a sample prompt and a note on who does what. Standard enlarges the set, adds a simple way to measure each one and puts them in a sensible order. Premium delivers a larger set with a one page start plan for the whole team, notes on risks and what not to share, and a check-in call. Add-ons include extra wins, a starter pack of prompts and a kickoff call with your team.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Start with one or two wins, finish them and then add more.
- Measure the time a task takes before you change it.
- Review the first results together as a team.
- Keep private details out of the prompts you use.
- Keep the wins that work and drop the ones that do not.

**Avoid:**
- Trying every idea in the first week.
- Skipping the check of what the tool produced.
- Using a quick win on a task where an error would be costly.
- Buying new software when a setting in a current tool would do.
- Forgetting to tell the team why the change is being made.

## Who this is for

This service suits a busy owner who wants results this month and has no time for a long project. It suits a team lead who wants something practical to show the team after hearing about AI. It also suits a small store that spends hours each week on product notes, replies and email, and wants simple relief.

It differs from an opportunity audit. The audit surveys the whole business and ranks the opportunities. A quick wins plan picks easy changes and gives you the steps to start straight away.

## What we need from you

A short description of your business, the main tasks your team repeats and the tools you already use. If you can, tell us which tasks feel slowest. We never ask for passwords. Because the plan is written from your description, no account access is needed.
